sources.review: Both filesystem kinds accept boolean true/false; other kinds short-circuit without snapshot; absent/null/string metadata rejects.
Missing resource, missing/null/different owner return false and exact single 404/error payload; same owner returns true without writing reply.

Acquire blocks concurrent execution; release permits reacquisition; repeated release and stale closure for a different owner cannot clear a newer lease. Same-ID reacquisition semantics intentionally unchanged.
Unset/empty/trimmed-empty use home/.jait; relative override rejects; absolute trimmed override preserved (Linux fixture). Platform behavior still requires supported-platform acceptance.
Existing global object preserved by identity; absent crypto filled with node WebCrypto including getRandomValues. Each branch executes in a fresh process.

CID lookup: case-insensitive, percent-decoded, angle-stripped, absent/empty fallback and malformed decode catch. All five accepted MIME types and rejected SVG/parameters; empty/invalid alphabet; base64url canonicalization; encoded length 1,500,000/+1 and decoded 1MiB/+1. The 1,398,101-byte input has an incomplete final sextet and decodes 1,048,575 bytes.

HS256 signer emits preview purpose/resource/subject and 3600s lifetime; verifier checks resource/purpose/string subject. Signed invalid claims, expired/not-yet-valid JWT, unsupported algorithm, wrong key and malformed token all reject. No real credentials or remote services.

No/empty Origin and four native app origins accepted. Malformed, opaque, non-HTTP, noncanonical (path/userinfo/case) reject. Exact host+port or trimmed comma CORS entry accept; mismatch/trailing slash reject.

Explicit trimmed gateway/local/remote/unknown routes; explicit remote overrides local path. Blank ID falls through. Existing local path wins before inference. Skip gateway, restrict Windows drive paths to Windows, choose first remote otherwise, null if none.

PowerShell basename/path/case/extension and rejection boundaries. Empty line, PS prompt and non-PS rejection; user@host, absolute/relative/home/drive prompts; simple hostname prompt and ordinary text rejects. Current PS regex accepts suffix after >.

Standard content/auth headers; Go recognized by backend or exact host+path; invalid URL caught without stripping explicit backend. Explicit > input > cached UUID identity precedence; repeated object reuses UUID; distinct object differs. Prefix false and wrong-host branches covered.

Five fields, length 256/+1, whitespace, wildcard, positive safe integer steps, every numeric field bound, lists, inclusive and equal ranges; malformed/empty/decimal/negative/list/range/step expressions reject. Tests characterize validator syntax, not scheduling semantics.

Deterministic zero/48-bit-max/mixed-byte timestamp, random bytes preserved outside RFC version/variant masks, zero-padded grouping, newActionId wrapper. Library WebCrypto fallback tested separately with format/timestamp invariant; entropy quality and same-ms monotonicity are not promised.

Deterministic zero/48-bit-max/mixed-byte timestamp, random bytes preserved outside RFC version/variant masks, zero-padded grouping, newActionId wrapper. Library WebCrypto fallback tested separately with format/timestamp invariant; entropy quality and same-ms monotonicity are not promised.

Empty list/count; unknown heartbeat null; register deduplicates capabilities; same-ID update preserves connectedAt and updates other fields; heartbeat updates lastSeen; two-record descending sort and unique count. Controlled clock prevents timing flakiness.

Missing round peek/count/post fallback; create/count, ordered timestamped posts, independent rounds, replacing a round resets messages/count, ending is idempotent and later messages disappear. Driver snapshots returned live arrays solely for transport, without altering production storage.

Explicit surface owner wins over session inference; missing registry/surface/session fails closed. Only pending consent for an owned session grants access. Tests substitute service interfaces, preserving policy logic.

sources.review: Diagram tools reject non-string, blank and over-limit source; accept exactly 20,000 characters. Title limit exactly 200; non-string/over-limit rejected; whitespace normalization and default title retained. Metadata compared explicitly.

Signed-in user and future parseable time required before service invocation. Exact-time/past/invalid denial, defaults, trimming, ID fallback, positive multi-device delivery and zero-device error checked with a frozen clock and service spy; no push sent.

Real file fixtures cover ordinary checkouts and missing marker, registered worktree read-only common metadata mount, symlink marker, invalid marker, wrong backlink, unregistered admin and colon path rejection. Paths and relative marker targets are resolved by production code.

Real Linux process identity: live own PID retained; wrong start/boot or dead PID rejected; malformed/unsafe PID owners conservatively retained. Gateway digest stable for trimmed/equivalent state paths, differs across state directories; owner field structure observed. Permission-denied /proc fallback remains a supported-platform limitation.

sources.review: Jait link inputs require registered internal routes and label. Search encodes Unicode/metacharacters and clears with empty string, rejects unsupported search pages and non-string search; unsupported paths/fragments/external URLs denied. Shared parser itself remains a separate review.

Freshness at 300000ms exact boundary, force bypass, in-flight sharing even when forced, independent keys, sync throw/rejection, failure classifier, exponential 10/20/30 minute cap, success reset, and 1000-entry capacity/expired eviction checked using deterministic clocks and promises.

Valid object configuration preserves unknown root/feature/mode fields and string namespace order, removes non-string entries, deduplicates and appends the core namespace. Blank input builds defaults; invalid JSON and every primitive/array JSON shape return the exact raw bytes unchanged. Constants checked independently; source review only, no CLI execution.

Exact six runtime SDK export names and identity with the defining SDK module. Re-export-only AST with erased type export. This credits the adapter only; SDK cryptography, runtime lifecycle and bundled native binding behavior remain separate.

All seven tool names, risk/consent policy and required fields checked; connect rejects secret/unknown fields, malformed URL and invalid types, allows the exact 512-character username, and returns private sign-in link without bridge calls. Six command wrappers use the actual shared schema, force their own action, retain defaults/normalization and user/signal forwarding to a spy. No real room is read or messaged.

Real NodeStateManager insertion/update/removal: default and explicit protocol, capability fallback and false/empty overrides, connected timestamp preservation and last-seen advancement under an injected clock, client rebinding, gateway exemption, foreign-client isolation, stable name ordering, snapshot protocol/time, disconnect lifecycle and missing IDs. In-memory registry only; transport behavior remains separate.

Runs the real execFile/promisify path against project-local ssh/scp stand-ins: literal option arrays, directory preparation before recursive copy, default/custom boundary ports, quote escaping and source slash normalization, stdout/stderr ordering, validation before launch, prepare failure preventing copy and copy failure propagation. No SSH keys, remote hosts or network used; process timeout and maxBuffer exhaustion are residual checks.

Production normalization covers first nonblank line, CR/LF, labels/list markers/quotes/whitespace/punctuation, empty output, exact 160 limit and word-versus-hard truncation. Generation covers trimmed blank short circuit, exact prompt/options/runtime forwarding, leading 1200 task characters and trailing 4000 response characters, successful normalization and provider failure fallback. Completion boundary is mocked; live model quality and the 12-second timer firing remain separate.

Real container metadata parser and DockerResourceInventory collect/cache policy: exact repository icon matching, sandbox classification, redacted fields, address deduplication, malformed rows, 512 cap and 32-ID argv batches, coalesced work, strict 30-second expiry and failure caching/recovery. Docker calls are an injected spy; default external Docker socket/process selection remains separate. No Docker daemon or network scan is used.

Maintenance tool execution with service/notification spies: specific and all repositories, pass/failure summaries and plan links, empty inventories, action ID forwarding and deterministic manual ID fallback, optional notifications and service/notification thrown failures. No repository checks run; maintenance service execution and routing remain separate.

Linux metadata-only setup against isolated artifact files: local readable/missing/directory/unreadable/blocked-parent paths, correctly quoted ACL guidance only for confirmed files, negative remote URL decisions without probing a key, and actual gateway identity metadata. No private-key contents are read, permission commands executed, or device/provider requests sent. Multi-location default search and non-Linux permission behavior remain separate.
Exact runtime exports and identity with independent defining imports; every AST statement is a re-export. Barrel-only source credit; dependencies and static type compatibility remain separate.

All runtime SDK helpers: fresh source metadata, forced source metadata overriding forged input while retaining tool fields and callback identity, setup forwarding, optional no-op disposal, explicit disposal and callback rejections. Static types and plugin orchestration remain separate.

Delegating wrapper metadata and exact dependency, input, context, result and rejection forwarding through a substituted createAgentSpawnTool boundary. No worker starts; inner authorization and scheduling remain separate.

Choice/score/noul conversion, empty criteria defaults, exact state/key/signal forwarding and answer serialization, non-array/empty/duplicate IDs and service failure fallback. External decision service is a spy; model/schema validation remains separate.

Four scheduler wrappers: user scoping, string/default handling, first underscore normalization, input preservation, update type filtering, missing/success responses and empty/disabled/25-row list formatting; scheduler rejection propagation. Scheduler spy only; actual scheduling/persistence/authorization remain separate.

Schema/query dispatch, missing/blank SQL refusal before service calls, literal SQL and max_rows forwarding, schema-shaped query results, exact row/truncation messages and service errors. Wrapper-only credit; enforcement and ownership remain separate service contracts.

Actual Node imports an unchanged isolated source copy: explicit cache wins, trimmed JAIT_STATE_DIR selects its cache, default HOME path, empty explicit cache fallback and actual enabled-cache location. Cache files stay in the project artifact tree. Node supported-cache path on Linux; older Node without the optional API remains separate.

Actual Node executes an isolated script at the real relative repository layout. Missing index leaves the existing bundle intact and exits zero; present index replaces stale files and copies nested assets while preserving the source. No production dist tree is touched.

Actual Node script resolves gateway-root build paths, explicit/default Bun executable, exact external-binding argv, inherited stdout, nonzero and signal status propagation and missing-executable errors. The builder is a local stub; no dependency build or download runs.

Actual Node script in an isolated package layout: development deferral versus packaged missing-runtime error, dynamic runtime import, progress callback and Error/primitive failure output. Fake ensureGraphifyRuntime is the provisioning boundary; no Python install or network call occurs.

Running-list filtering and connection-port defaults/zero overrides; trimmed explicit selection, stopped/missing errors, last-running fallback and driver construction with exact Windows credentials or Linux manager identity. Constructors and inventory are spies; no desktop, SSH, VM or Docker action occurs.

List/start/stop wrappers, empty/list preview and session suffix, context/default overrides, generic versus inspected-browser routing, foreign browser-session denial, snapshot/result merging and exact success/missing/error outcomes. Registry, browser inspector and UUID boundaries are spies; actual browser/surface lifecycle remains separate.

Exit-code versus signal detection, already-exited idempotence, subscribe-before-kill with a synchronous exit fixture, and actual local Node child SIGTERM/repeated cleanup. No server or external command is started. The ten-second abort fallback remains a separate timeout check.

Real Fastify injection and real signed authentication for read/halt/resume, trimmed/invalid reasons, per-user service arguments, exact audit records, partial runner failure and best-effort audit failure. Service and audit are spies; no real runner is stopped.

Real authenticated Fastify handlers for all plugin routes: config shallow-merge order, read/list/scan, lifecycle success, missing plugin, unauthenticated denial before effects and Error/primitive failure mapping. Plugin manager is a spy; no plugin is installed or activated.

Real Fastify handlers with screen-share/WebSocket spies: device coercion and authorization flag, validation, start/control/stop event order, absent stop, state/devices/capture/record, Error and primitive failures. Gateway-wide auth and actual capture/signaling remain separate; no screen or device is accessed.

Real Fastify/JWT list/get/run handlers: limit default/clamping/coercion, job filter, missing runs, body validation, ordered run/broadcast/notification effects, failed-check plan response and service error mapping. External service/notifications/WebSocket are spies; no repository checks run.

Real request/complete/register/unregister/stop lifecycle: owner and active-tab selection, gateway precedence, validation order, response sender/user/request identity and shape, output bounds, callback errors, replacement/disconnect, abort/timeout and 32-request cap with timer cleanup. Browser sends and gateway handler are local spies; no room or external messaging service is contacted. Arbitrary synchronous callback reentrancy and wire integration remain separate.

Production cookie normalization, Go status/schema handling and exact request policy, explicit HTML-meter extraction, duplicate/range/missing-meter errors, date normalization, exact 2,000,000-character/byte boundaries and reader cancellation on success/error. Global fetch is a local spy; HTML is parsed by the real parser and never executed. No credentials or external provider requests are used; real transport timeout/redirect execution remains separate.

Prompt injection stays a fixed discovery instruction: the rendered skills block is independent of catalog size and never lists skill names, descriptions, or filesystem paths; an empty catalog renders nothing.

Model-bound payloads drop terminal echoes (terminalOutputAnsi always; terminalOutput only when a canonical output exists) while UI data keeps them; oversized envelopes truncate to valid JSON with bounded binary-search previews, intact UTF-16 pairs, and retained execution/evidence scalars; message-deduplicated serialization stays bounded.

Codex/ACP counters accept nested and snake_case shapes with cache and request counts, reject impossible or unsafe totals, and accumulate cumulative session notifications as baseline deltas only: repeated, older, and resumed-lifetime totals are never double-charged, fresh sessions charge first reports fully, turn-scoped usage replaces per request id, and metrics stay provider-reported with matching totals.
